findings.title: Startup indexing races on shared state
findings.body: Calling `Init` during construction runs `searchSupport.init` immediately, where multiple errgroup workers concurrently increment `totalBatchesIndexed` and assign to the shared `err` variable. This is a data race, and concurrent error assignments can cause initialization to return the wrong result. Use per-worker local errors and an atomic or synchronized counter before enabling parallel startup indexing.

findings.title: Concurrent builds can open the same Bleve index
findings.body: The build-wide lock has been removed, but `getOrCreateIndex` can still have multiple callers observe a cache miss for the same key and call `BuildIndex` concurrently. For file-backed indexes, both builds use the same directory, so concurrent `bleve.New` calls can fail or interfere; even if both complete, whichever stores last replaces the cached index. Serialize builds per key or recheck the cache before creating the index.
